about: R4 held-out set: 62 original researcher requests written on Oct 31 for R4 (cloud ruling of Oct 31, 08:45 UTC) by an agent that did not see or write any R4 prompt or schema change, committed before any prompt or schema change. Same class composition as eval/planner_questions_v2_heldout.json. Expected outcomes follow stillhere/validation_table.json and planner.DECLINE_REASONS as they stood when written, and v0's scoring (docs/rules/planner_eval_rule.md, stillhere/planner_eval.py): a decline is correct when its reason is one of the listed reasons; on an accept only the named spec fields are scored. No film, story or confidential text.
